ticket.summary: Active water leak pouring through dining room ceiling light fixture, likely from upstairs bathroom; customer closed house main near water heater in garage and bled pressure — on-call dispatched tonight.
mitigation_advice: Shut off the house main (wheel clockwise); located it by the water heater in the garage [PB-02]
Stay clear of the sagging water-heavy ceiling and do not touch the light fixture or switch [PB-08]
Try the fixture shutoff under the upstairs toilet/sink if safely reachable [PB-01]
Open the lowest cold tap (basement sink) to drain remaining line pressure [PB-03]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Maria — 31 Halcyon Ct is dispatched to our on-call plumber, and he'll call your number on the way. Keep the main off and the basement tap open until he arrives, stay out from under that ceiling and leave the dining room light switch alone. Towels and the bucket are a good call — hang tight, help is on the way.
